field_descriptions.event: Stable event name identifying an auditable policy decision.
field_descriptions.schema_version: Version of the uncompressed decision-ledger record.
field_descriptions.selection: Exact original simulator option indices returned by the policy.
field_descriptions.decision_phase: Policy phase that selected the returned action.
field_descriptions.decision_phase_reason: Stable reason code for the winning phase.
field_descriptions.fallback_used: Whether the deterministic fallback produced the action.
field_descriptions.model_backend: Ranking backend that produced the decision.
field_descriptions.model_version: Immutable backend or model version identifier.
field_descriptions.duration_ms: End-to-end policy decision duration in milliseconds.
field_descriptions.trace: Complete DecisionTrace for this public observation.
field_descriptions.ranked: All legal selections in final ranking order with scores and reasons.
field_descriptions.features: All feature vectors calculated for legal selections.
field_descriptions.turn_ledger: Public evidence accumulated during the current turn.
field_descriptions.match_ledger: Public evidence accumulated during the current match.
field_descriptions.candidates: All actor-visible simulator options before selection generation.
field_descriptions.stages: Candidate populations before and after each policy filter.
field_descriptions.ranked_scores: Trace copy of every ranked selection, score, and reason list.
field_descriptions.option: Verbatim public CABT option map; its keys are not renamed.
field_descriptions.card: Verbatim public card map attached to an option; its keys are not renamed.
field_descriptions.attack: Verbatim public attack map attached to an option; its keys are not renamed.
field_descriptions.values: Numeric feature vector in the declared feature-schema order.
field_descriptions.reasons: Stable policy reason codes supporting a ranking or decision.
field_descriptions.select_context: Simulator selection context for this policy call.
field_descriptions.min_count: Minimum option count accepted by the simulator.
field_descriptions.max_count: Maximum option count accepted by the simulator.
field_descriptions.remain_energy_cost: Energy cost still required by the active selection prompt.
field_descriptions.remain_damage_counter: Damage-counter requirement still required by the prompt.
field_descriptions.selected_indices: Exact selected option indices stored in the DecisionTrace.
field_descriptions.objective_before: Persistent objective before ranking this observation.
field_descriptions.objective_after: Persistent objective after committing the selection.
field_descriptions.policy_variant: Declared policy variant that produced the trace.
field_descriptions.source_commit: Required source revision recorded by the extracted package manifest.
field_descriptions.package_sha256: Required immutable payload SHA-256 recorded by the extracted package manifest.
field_descriptions.option_index: Original zero-based simulator index of one candidate option.
field_descriptions.option_type: Normalized type of one candidate option.
field_descriptions.name: Name of a trace stage.
field_descriptions.before: Selection indices present before a filter stage.
field_descriptions.after: Selection indices remaining after a filter stage.
field_descriptions.removed: Selection indices removed by a filter stage.
field_descriptions.reason: Stable reason for a stage transition or fallback record.
field_descriptions.indices: Original simulator indices represented by one selection.
field_descriptions.score: Final numerical score assigned to one selection.
field_descriptions.rank: One-based final rank of a selection.
field_descriptions.margin_to_next: Score margin between this selection and the next rank.
field_descriptions.heuristic_score: Reference heuristic score retained with a feature vector.
field_descriptions.heuristic_reasons: Reference heuristic reason codes retained with a feature vector.

turn_ledger_fields.own_turn: Ordinal number of the agent's own turn.
